children: WASHINGTON, Sept 17 (Reuters) - The U.S. Treasury Department said its Dutch bidding auction of 9-yr 10-mo indexed notes brought these results:
Price              97.598142    Accepted at high   93.14%    Bid-to-cover ratio 2.24

Total accepted                 19,000,006,000    Total public bids tendered     42,485,982,000    Competitive bids accepted      18,883,984,000    Noncompetitive bids accepted      116,022,000    Fed add-ons                     2,860,448,000    Primary Dealer Tendered        23,306,000,000    Primary Dealer Accepted         2,300,024,000    Direct Bidder Tendered          6,875,000,000    Direct Bidder Accepted          5,419,000,000    Indirect Bidder Tendered       12,188,960,000    Indirect Bidder Accepted       11,164,960,000
Issued date    Sept 30, 2026    Maturity date  July 15, 2036    CUSIP number   91282CRE3
Dutch auctions are also called uniform-price auctions.Successful bidders pay only the price of the lowest acceptedbid, rather than the actual price they bid as in amultiple-price auction.
